rewrites.//: MUST come first. The previous config had only the SPA catch-all, which would rewrite /api/* to index.html and make every function unreachable.
Unchanged SPA fallback — this is what keeps client-side routing working.

headers.//: API responses may carry session state. A shared cache must never store them.
Stops the browser second-guessing declared content types, which is how a text upload becomes executable script.
Send the full URL to our own origin, only the bare origin cross-site. Prevents leaking share-token paths in Referer headers.
No framing at all — nothing here is designed to be embedded, and this closes clickjacking of the admin panel.
Force HTTPS for two years, including subdomains. Vercel terminates TLS, so this is safe.
Isolates this origin's browsing context group from cross-origin popups.
Certificate scans and screenshots are content-hashed by nature (they change name, not content) — cache them hard.
